{{Quote|A gem among the smaller capital ships.|Ushos O. Statura|<ref name="Rebel Files" />}}
The '''''Braha'tok''-class gunship''', also known as the '''Dornean gunship''' or shortened to '''Braha'tok''', was a model of [[gunship]] designed by the [[Dornean]] [[species]] and built by the [[Dornean Braha'ket Fleetworks Conglomerate]] to protect the Dornean [[homeworld]], [[Dornea]], and its [[star system]] from the [[Galactic Empire]]. Standing at 90 [[meter]]s long, the vessel was armed with eight [[turbolaser]] [[cannon]]s and eight [[concussion missile launcher]]s and could carry two [[starfighter]]s in its underbelly, linked to attachment clips. The Braha'toks were designed as dedicated anti-starfighter platforms but were able to serve a number of other roles.

Following the [[Dornean treaty]] with [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]]'s secret rebellion, which [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance|became]] officially known as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], ''Braha'tok''-class gunships began serving with the rebels. Three of the gunships, including the [[Orion (starship)|''Orion'']], fought in the [[Battle of Atollon]] in [[2 BBY]] and at least another three took part in the [[Battle of Scarif]] in [[1 BBY]].

One ''Braha'tok''-class gunship named the ''[[Apailana's Promise]]'' served as escort to the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Thunderstrike]]'' for the Alliance's [[61st Mobile Infantry]] in [[3 ABY]], protecting the larger vessel from [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] in numerous battles and distracting the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Herald]]'' during the [[Siege of Inyusu Tor]] to protect rebel [[Alliance Army|ground forces]]. At least four Braha'toks joined the Alliance [[fleet]] at the [[Battle of Endor]].

The ''Apailana's Promise'' came to serve the [[New Republic]] in the [[Battle of Jakku]], the final battle of the war, in [[5 ABY]]. Despite being considered outdated by [[Admiral]] [[Ushos O. Statura]], these gunships continued to protect Dornea as late as [[34 ABY]]. In [[35 ABY]], at least four gunships fought with the [[Citizens' Fleet]] against the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] during the [[Battle of Exegol]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Brahatok-EOS.png|thumb|left|350px|A ''Braha'tok''-class gunship was considered to be dagger-like by Hazram Namir.]]
The ''Braha'tok''-class gunship,<ref name="Rebel Files" /> also referred to as the Dornean gunship<ref name="Lost Stars">''[[Lost Stars]]''</ref> or simply Braha'tok, was a type of [[gunship]], built at 90 [[meter]]s long (295 [[Foot|feet]] and 3 inches),<ref name="Starfighters2" /> which bordered the line between being a [[gunboat]] or a [[corvette]]. Produced by the [[Dornean Braha'ket Fleetworks Conglomerate]], the gunship cost a total of 1,400,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> and could reach [[Atmosphere|atmospheric]] speeds of 800 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]],<ref name="Starfighters" /> and sublight speeds of 80 [[megalight per hour]] in [[realspace]].<ref name="Starfighters2" /> The vessel was narrow with a similar resemblance to a [[CR90 corvette]].<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> The rebel [[soldier]] [[Hazram Namir]] described one Braha'tok to be a mean, compact, dagger of a ship.<ref name="Twilight Company">''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]''</ref> It also had a [[silver]]-plated [[hull]] to deflect [[Star|solar]] [[radiation]]<ref name="Starfighters" /> which was very durable. That was reinforced by the quick cycling [[deflector shield generator]]s that could protect from rapid-fire weapons,<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> the primary generator being located at the dorsal side of the gunship's middle section.<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

The ''Braha'tok''-class gunship had a complement of 70 [[officer]]s and other enlisted crew, and could carry 15 passengers. Additionally, it had a encumbrance capacity of 300 and enough consumables to last eight [[Standard month|months]]. For systems, the [[Starship|vessel]] possessed a [[navigation computer]] as well as a long range [[sensor]] systems,<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> though it was not equipped for interstellar encryption.<ref name="Twilight Company" /> The Braha'tok had a class 3 primary [[hyperdrive]] and a class 15 backup hyperdrive,<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> located between two<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> of its three [[sublight engine]] units at the rear of the ship. The command [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] was situated in<ref name="Starfighters" /> the armored command module that made up the ship's bow.<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" />

[[File:BrahatokClassGunship-USWNE.png|thumb|right|300px|''Braha'tok''-class gunships were said to be densely armed.]]
''Braha'tok''-class gunships were considered to be powerful for their size,<ref name="Rebel Files" /> bearing an armament of eight [[concussion missile launcher]]s and eight<ref name="Starfighters" /> double [[turbolaser]] [[cannon]]s.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> While the bow of the gunship bore a dorsal and a ventral twin turbolaser cannon, the center of the vessel had turbolaser cannons positioned on the port, starboard, dorsal and ventral sides,<ref name="Rogue One" /> and the final two twin turbolasers were situated under its rear wings.<ref name="Starfighter Missions" /> Aside from these, the gunship was also able to deploy flares.<ref name="Twilight Company" /> As well as weaponry, the Braha'tok could carry two [[starfighter]]s, linked to attachment clips located on the port and starboard sides towards the center of the vessel.<ref name="Starfighters" /> Modifications could allow the gunship to carry additional starfighters and even a small [[freighter]].<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

==Role==
[[File:Dorneans_vs_ISDs.png|thumb|left|280px|A trio of ''Braha'tok''-class gunships engage Imperial starships.]]
The ''Braha'tok''-gunships was designed by the [[Dornean]] [[species]],<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> becoming the representative ship of their race.<ref name="Starfighter Missions">''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]''</ref> As small [[capital ship]]s, they were designed<ref name="Starfighters2" /> as dedicated anti-starfighter platforms and served as screening vessels, defending larger vessels from starfighters and other small capital ships like corvettes or [[frigate]]s. Typically deployed in pairs, the gunships had the ability to take on swarms of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] and pose a threat to small capital ships, although the Braha'toks were not equipped for extended fights with larger starships. The ''Braha'tok''-class gunship could also be used as a mobile base of operations.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

Initially manufactured as patrol ships<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" /> for the protection of [[Dornea]], the Dornean [[homeworld]], from the [[Galactic Empire]],<ref name="SWECG" /> many Braha'toks became a part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="Starfighters" /> and the Alliance's successor<ref name="Alphabet Squadron">[[Alphabet Squadron (novel)|''Alphabet Squadron'']]</ref> the [[New Republic]].<ref name="Victory's Price" /> In the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]], the gunships were still used for their aforementioned roles<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> as well as fast attack and bombardment.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> Use of Braha'toks by [[pirate]]s was also known of.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

==History==
===Early rebel service===
{{Quote|Commander, They've destroyed the ''Orion''.|A rebel, reporting the ''Orion''{{'s}} destruction|<ref name="Zero Hour">{{Rebels|Zero Hour}}</ref>}}
The ''Braha'tok''-class gunship was initially used to protect Dornea<ref name="SWECG" /> and patrol its [[star system]],<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" /> the [[Dornea system]],<ref name="Systems">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}}</ref> against the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Starfighters" /> The [[Dornean treaty]] with [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]]'s secret rebellion, later [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance|officialised]] at the Rebel Alliance, saw some of these gunships enter service with the rebel in their [[Galactic Civil War]] against the Empire. The vessels and were listed by the [[Mon Calamari]] [[aide]]s [[Caitken]] and [[Shollan]] as a part of the major composition of rebel starships—alongside [[Pelta-class frigate|''Pelta''-class frigates]], CR90 corvettes, [[CR70 corvette]]s, [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvettes]], and [[GR-75 medium transport]]s—in a document sent by [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]] to Mothma sometime after the [[Blockade of Ibaar]],<ref name="Rebel Files" /> which took place in [[4 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>

[[File:Zero_Hour_thumb.png|thumb|right|350px|Three ''Braha'tok''-class gunships fought above Atollon]]
In [[2 BBY]], shortly after the Alliance's declaration,<ref name="Timelines" /> three ''Braha'tok''-class gunships part of the [[Massassi Group]] rebel cell, including the [[Orion (starship)|''Orion'']], were among a [[fleet]] led by [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] which amassed with another rebel cell named [[Phoenix Cell]] above the<ref name="Zero Hour" /> [[planet]]<ref name="SWECG" /> [[Atollon]]. The two forces amassed in preparation for an [[Attack on Lothal|attack]] on the<ref name="Zero Hour" /> planet<ref name="SWECG" /> [[Lothal]]'s [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE defender]] factory. However, an Imperial [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|fleet]] led by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] arrived out of [[hyperspace]] and [[blockade]]d the planet with the assistance of two [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser]]. A [[Battle of Atollon|battle]] ensued, and although numerous rebel starships were destroyed in the battle initially, the three Braha'toks gunships remained intact. As the Alliance's initial tactics became too costly, [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]] of Phoenix Cell ordered the fleet to charge the blockade, which saw the three Braha'toks at the vanguard of the assault. However, the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] thwarted the assault and the ''Orion'' was destroyed by TIE fighters.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

With the more rebel vessels falling to Thrawn's fleet, Sato crashed his [[flagship]], the ''[[Phoenix Nest]]'', into one [[Kassius Konstantine's Interdictor|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser]] to allow one of his ships to escape and seek help from allies. The rest of the rebel forces soon fled to Phoenix Cell's base on the surface of Atollon after Dodonna's [[Vanguard|flagship]] was too destroyed. The starships housed themselves under the shield of the base, awaiting Thrawn's incoming ground forces. When the Imperial forces overran the base shortly after, several rebel vessels, including a ''Braha'tok''-class gunship, escaped and flew up to Atollon's orbit to try and bypass Thrawn's blockade, where the second [[Constrainer|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser]]. As the fleeing forces ran the blockade, the Braha'tok was lost.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

===Battle of Scarif===
{{Quote|All ships make a jump to hyperspace.|Raddus, to the ships of the Alliance Fleet|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
[[File:BrahatokOverScarif-RO.png|thumb|left|300px|A ''Braha'tok''-class gunship orbiting Scarif.]]
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Raddus, aboard his flagship the [[MC75 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Profundity]]'', gathered vessels of the Alliance Fleet above<ref name="Rogue One 5">[[Rogue One Adaptation 5|''Rogue One Adaptation'' 5]]</ref> the [[moon]]<ref name="SWECG" /> [[Yavin 4]], where there Alliance's [[Great Temple|headquarters]] was located at the time, in preparation to assist a rebel [[Battle of Scarif|attack]] on the<ref name="Rebel Files" /> planet<ref name="SWECG" /> [[Scarif]]. He sent a report to Mothma to inform her that he was scrambling Alliance forces, with a count of two to four ''Braha'tok''-class gunships being noted in his expected fleet composition.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> At least three Braha'toks ultimately traveled with Raddus's to Scarif. While a portion rebel starfighters were able to pass through Scarif's [[Shield Gate]] to assist the [[Rogue One|ground forces]], the rest of the fleet engaged the pair of Star Destroyers and their TIE fighters above and the ''Braha'tok''-class gunships helped fight the TIEs weaving between the rebel starships.<ref name="Rogue One" />

Once the main objective had been completed, Raddus ordered the fleet to jump to hyperspace. Although many ships were able to escape, the Star Destroyer ''[[Devastator]]'' arrived and cut off the rest.<ref name="Rogue One" /> One ''Braha'tok''-class gunship barely avoided collision with the Star Destroyer but managed to escape soon after.<ref name="Starfighters" /> The Battle of Scarif was ultimately a success for the Alliance,<ref name="Rogue One" /> and after another rebel victory at the [[Battle of Yavin]], Dornea decided to join the rebel cause, supplying more ''Braha'tok''-class gunships for the Alliance fleet.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

===Twilight Company===
====Escort duty====
During the Galactic Civil War, one rebel ''Braha'tok''-class gunship named the ''Apailana's Promise'', or simply ''Promise''. served as the escort to the CR90 corvette ''[[Thunderstrike]]'', the carrier of the Alliance's [[61st Mobile Infantry]]—better known as Twilight Company. The gunship carried two [[X-wing starfighter]]s for the company and the vessel's crew of a few dozen navy veterans came to collectively owe Twilight Company nearly 50,000 credits.<ref name="Twilight Company" />

In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> the ''Promise'' traveled with Twilight Company to the planet [[Haidoral Prime]], where the company [[Attack on Haidoral Prime|defeated]] the defending Imperial forces and extracted [[Governor]] [[Everi Chalis]], whom wished to defect to the company. Three [[Standard day|days]] later, the two ships crossed paths with an Imperial reconnaissance squadron, leading to a short [[Battle in the Kontahr sector|battle]] between the two opposing sides. The ''Thunderstrike'' and ''Apailana's Promise'' took minor systems damages during the exchange of fire and the ''Promise'' lost three of its crew. Days later, the gunship's X-wings assisted Twilight Company during a [[Coyerti campaign|campaign]] on the [[jungle]] planet [[Coyerti]].<ref name="Twilight Company" />

====Evading Imperial pursuit====
{{Quote|We've been lucky so far. The Empire hasn't had forces positioned to do more than harry us.|Sairgon reflects on the Imperial attacks|<ref name="Twilight Company" />}}
[[File:Brahatok-RF.png|thumb|right|350px|A ''Braha'tok''-class gunship from above]]
Three days after their departure from Coyerti, the ''Thunderstrike'' and ''Apailana's Promise'' were [[Battle in the Metatessu sector|attacked]] by an [[Destroyer (Galactic Empire)|Imperial destroyer]]. The ''Promise'' and its X-wings were quick to defend the ''Thunderstrike'' and they soon escaped. The two starships were then [[Battle in the Enrivi system|ambushed]] thirty [[Standard hour|hours]] later in the [[Enrivi system]] by a [[light cruiser]] and a TIE fighter squadron. The ''Thunderstrike'' and ''Apailana's Promise'' destroyed the attackers, and the pair were [[Battle in the Chonsetta system|attacked]] again nineteen hours after that in the [[Chonsetta system]] by a squadron of [[TIE/IN interceptor|TIE interceptors]] which had been hiding in a comet trail.<ref name="Twilight Company" />

It was soon discovered that the ''Thunderstrike''{{'s}} hyperdrive was leaking [[hypermatter]] for the Empire to follow. [[Captain]] [[Micha Evon]], the [[commanding officer]] of Twilight Company, held a meeting with the bridge crew of both the ''Thunderstrike'' and ''Apailana's Promise'' as well as senior members of the company to discuss a solution for this. In this meeting, it was decided that Twilight Company was to seize supplies from an Imperial cargo [[transport]]. Thus the ''Promise'' traveled with the ''Thunderstrike'' to the [[Redhurne system]] and hid behind an [[asteroid]] belt which had once been part of a planet in anticipation of a target. The two vessels waited two hours until an [[Unidentified Imperial heavy freighter|Imperial heavy freighter]] and [[Raid on an Imperial heavy freighter|ambushed]] it from both sides.<ref name="Twilight Company" />

Flanked both ways, the freighter chose to veer away from the ''Promise'' to avoid the gunships considerable firepower and move towards the ''Thunderstrike''. The corvette returned fire at the [[Imperial heavy freighter]] and launched at least six [[boarding pod]]s carrying [[squad]]s of [[rebel trooper]]s to infiltrate the cargo transport. The ''Promise'' fended off the TIE fighters that defended the freighter while the ''Thunderstrike's'' continued firing upon the transport to keep its crew occupied. When an Imperial [[Gozanti-class cruiser]] soon arrived to join the battle, Evon hastened the withdrawal of the boarding party to the ''Thunderstrike''. As the two ships then jumped out of the system under heavy fire, the ''Promise'' lost its deflector shield generator trying to block fire from the ''Thunderstrike''. The mission, though, was a success, with the needed supplies obtained.<ref name="Twilight Company" />

====Imperial infiltration====
{{Quote|The ''Thunderstrike'' and the ''Promise'' will rendezvous with three other battle groups in deep space. We've allocated a month to get both ships back in shape and let the company heal up.|Micha Evon, to Hazram Namir|<ref name="Twilight Company" />}}
With the supplies obtained to repair the ''Thunderstrike'', Evon arranged for the corvette and the ''Promise'' to meet with three other [[battle group]]s in the [[Elochar sector]], allocating a month for both to get repairs while the captain, Chalis, [[First Sergeant]] Hazram Namir, and two others visited the [[Alliance High Command]] on the planet [[Hoth]]. Ten days after the ''Thunderstrike'' and ''Apailana's Promise'' joined the flotilla, the former took aboard survivors from the [[light freighter]] ''[[Trumpet's Call]]'' after the vessel arrived without working [[life support]]. The survivors, however, were Imperial [[Spy|spies]]. The spies attacked the ''Thunderstrike's'' bridge and killed the officers, but not before [[Lieutenant]] [[Sairgon]] was able to warn the rest of the flotilla. Only the ''Thunderstrike'' and ''Apailana's Promise'' remained as the other rebel starships fled.<ref name="Twilight Company" />

When<ref name="Twilight Company" /> the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Rebel Files" /> the ''[[Herald]]'' to apprehend Chalis, the ''Promise'', whose crew was unaware of the situation aboard the ''Thunderstrike'', put itself between the corvette and the [[Star Destroyer]] to protect the former from turbolaser fire. After the spies aboard the ''Thunderstrike'' were killed, the ''Promise'' received new coordinates and followed the corvette into hyperspace.<ref name="Twilight Company" />

====Operation Ringbreaker====
{{Quote|Technically command falls to me, after Howl and Sairgon and Paonu and—well. Sharn, would you object to a voice vote?''"<br />"''Your company, your show. The ''Promise'' will back you either way.|Von Geiz and Sharn|audio=GeizSharn-BTC.flac|<ref name="Twilight Company" />}}
[[File:Brahatok-SM.png|thumb|left|250px|A ''Braha'tok''-class gunship from below]]
The ''Thunderstrike'' and ''Apailana's Promise'' retreated to the planet [[Ankhural]], where the ''Thunderstrike'' received repairs on the ground while a skeleton crew worked on the ''Promise'' in [[orbit]]. Namir and Chalis soon arrived with news that Howl and the rest of their group had been killed during an [[Battle of Hoth|attack]] on Hoth.<ref name="Twilight Company" />

Chalis soon proposed a new mission for Twilight Company during a meeting between senior members of Twilight Company. Named [[Operation Ringbreaker]], it sought to force redeployments from the [[Kuat Drive Yards]] by attacking soft Imperial targets along the [[Rimma Trade Route]]. [[Sharn]], the second-in-command of the ''Apailana's Promise'', represented the gunship during the meeting and pledged the vessel's support for Twilight Company's final decision. A subsequent vote went in favor of Operation Ringbreaker, and the ''Thunderstrike'' and ''Promise'' soon departed from Ankhural and began their new mission. Commander [[Tohna]], an officer aboard the ''Promise'', was transferred to the ''Thunderstrike'' to take charge of its bridge crew and left the gunship with high praise from his peers.<ref name="Twilight Company" />

During Twilight Company's [[Attack on Mardona III|deployment]] on the warehouse planet [[Mardona III]] as a part of Operation Ringbreaker, the ''Thunderstrike'' and ''Promise'' flew through the atmosphere at close proximity, being chased by hundreds of TIE fighters. Once the company's [[dropship]]s deployed the troops from the ''Thunderstrike'', the corvette and the ''Promise'' left the system, later returning upon Namir's signal to retrieve the soldiers under the cover of a storm. After Mardona III, Twilight Company attacked a number of other Imperial installations before putting in for repairs on the junker world [[Heap Nine]]. After another successful [[Attack on the Kuliquo belt asteroid mines|mission]], only the planets [[Sullust]] and [[Malastare]] remained for Twilight Company to attack before the planet [[Kuat]] and its [[shipyard]].<ref name="Twilight Company" />

====Siege of Inyusu Tor====
{{Quote|Twilight? This is the ''Promise''. We've been ambushed—the whole blasted swarm came in from behind the moon. They were waiting for the ''Thunderstrike'' to hit atmo…|A female crew member|<ref name="Twilight Company" />}}
[[File:ThunderstrikeAndApailanasPromise-XWSE.png|thumb|right|350px|The ''Apailana's Promise'' (left) and ''Thunderstrike'' (right) above Sullust]]
The ''Thunderstrike'' and ''Apailana's Promise'' jumped out of hyperspace so within half a million [[kilometer]]s of Sullust, with the sudden clench of [[gravity]] almost tearing the two vessels apart. Twilight Company was [[Siege of Inyusu Tor|deployed]] and captured the [[Inyusu Tor mineral processing facility]]. However, when the ''Thunderstrike'' and ''Promise'', they faced a heavy amount of TIE fighters presence and gunship covered the corvettes flank. Realizing that the [[Vixus Squadron|squadron]] of TIEs had ambushed them, the ''Promise'' reported the trap to Namir on the ground and he ordered the ships pull up. The ''Thunderstrike'' instead plummeted and crashed on Sullust, with the ''Promise'' and its X-wings fleeing the Sullust.<ref name="Twilight Company" />

Now stranded on Sullust, Twilight Company set up defense at the Inyusu Tor facility and attempted to contact the ''Promise'' and determine its position, although they could not maintain a channel for more than a [[Standard minute|minute]]. After Namir was missing in action in the nearby [[city]] [[Pinyumb]], Chalis devised a plan to hijack ships in the [[Pinyumb spaceport]] and flee under the cover of the ''Promise''. However, Namir returned to Twilight Company and with the decision for the company to stay and defend the facility.<ref name="Twilight Company" />

The ''Promise'' later returned to Sullust with its X-wings and distracted the ''Herald'', which was there to destroy Twilight Company. Late into the battle, Chalis allowed herself to be captured by the ''Herald'' on a [[Thief|stolen]] [[shuttle]] and she set off around twenty [[Ion bomb]]s, crippling the Star Destroyer's power, forcing its withdrawal from Sullust. By that time, the ''Promise'' had drained its [[laser]] batteries and overheated its [[deflector shield]]s.<ref name="Twilight Company" />

===Late stages of the war===
{{Quote|The ''Promise'' just reported in. No sighting of Shadow Wing's bulk freighter.|A bridge officer aboard the ''Deliverance'', to Hera Syndulla|<ref name="Victory's Price" />}}
At some point after the Battle of Hoth, a few ''Braha'tok''-class gunships were stationed at the rebel base on the planet [[5251977]] when the crew of the light freighter ''[[Mighty Oak Apocalypse]]'' joined the Alliance.<ref name="Lost Stars" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Alliance leadership started planning an attack on the Empire's [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] superweapon at the [[forest]] moon of [[Endor]]. Admiral [[Gial Ackbar]] began drawing in critical Alliance Fleet elements to amass a suitable enough to be their attack force, listing the Braha'tok in his summary of the Alliance's main fleet structure in an official document to Mothma.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> Seven of the gunships rendezvoused with the Alliance Fleet near Sullust in preparation for the attack,<ref name="Odyssy of Star Wars">''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]''</ref> where one flew in concert with the [[MC80 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Home One]]''.<ref name="Episode VI" /> The fleet then jumped down the [[Sanctuary Pipeline]] [[hyperspace route]] on to [[Battle of Endor|attack]] the where they were quickly cut off by several dozen Star Destroyers.<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref>

[[File:Battle_of_Endor.jpg|thumb|left|350px|A ''Braha'tok''-class gunship (to the lower left of the CR90 corvette) during the Battle of Endor.]]
During the battle, a ''Braha'tok''-class gunship was steered into position within the battlefield to physically screen Alliance rescue vessels, while they attended to damaged starfighters.<ref name="Starfighters2" /> Another gunship fought TIE starfighters when<ref name="Episode VI" /> the [[YT-1300 light freighter]]<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' passed nearby. When General [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] ordered the fleet to engage the Star Destroyers, at least four of the gunships flew at the vanguard of the fleet as it closed in on the blockade. As the battle drew to a close, at least two Braha'toks escaped with the rest of the fleet as it flew towards Endor, away from the Death Star as it exploded.<ref name="Episode VI" /> Meanwhile, Mothma's [[archivist]] [[Hendri Underholt]] had compiled all of the documents mentioning the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship in his archive known as ''[[The Rebel Files]]''. He was killed during a [[Bombardment of Durkteel|bombardment]] of the planet [[Durkteel]] the same day as the Battle of Endor, ''The Rebel Files'' getting buried in the process.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

In [[5 ABY]], the Alliance, which had since reorganized into the New Republic, [[Battle of Jakku|attacked]] the Empire at the planet [[Jakku]].<ref name="Timelines" /> The ''Apailana's Promise'' was among the New Republic's [[New Republic Defense Fleet|fleet]], and aided the refitted New Republic Star Destroyer ''[[Deliverance]]'' in looking out for the Empire's [[204th Imperial Fighter Wing]], better known as Shadow Wing. The ''Promise'' reported no sightings of the [[fighter wing]]'s flagship, the [[bulk freighter]] ''[[Yadeez]]'', and General [[Hera Syndulla]] was informed of the report aboard the ''Deliverance''.<ref name="Victory's Price" /> The New Republic ultimately won the battle, which marked the end of the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Timelines" />

===New Republic Era===
{{Quote|Who still uses these?''"<br />"''Dornea, my dear Statura. Dornea uses them.|Ushos O. Statura and Gial Ackbar|<ref name="Rebel Files" />}}
[[File:PossibleBrahatok-WWOPtB.png|thumb|350px|right|A ''Braha'tok''-class gunship was docked at the pirate spaceport Borgo Prime.]]
In the years after the Galactic Civil War, ''Braha'tok''-class gunships were still used by the Dorneans to protect Dornea.<ref name="SWECG" /> By this point,<ref name="Way Way Out">{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}}</ref> the gunships had seen use from pirates in the Outer Rim Territories, with one captain at one point using one to raid local shipping lanes.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> A ''Braha'tok''-class gunship was kept at the<ref name="Way Way Out" /> Outer Rim<ref name="Smuggler's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]''</ref> pirate [[spaceport]]<ref name="Way Way Out" /> [[Borgo Prime]]<ref name="Smuggler's Guide" /> around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="9 ABY">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> when the pirate ship ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'' arrived for repairs.<ref name="Way Way Out" />

In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="34 ABY">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' establishes that ''[[The Rebel Files]]'' were buried on the same [[Standard day|day]] as the [[Battle of Endor]], which takes place in [[4 ABY]], according to ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. Since ''Star Wars: The Rebel Files'' also establishes that the files were rediscovered thirty [[Standard year|years]] later, they must have been [[Excavation on Durkteel|uncovered]] in [[34 ABY]].</ref> the ''The Rebel Files'' were uncovered in an [[Excavation on Durkteel|excavation]] and reached the [[Resistance]], a private military with Alliance roots which was formed to combat the Empire's successor, the [[First Order]]. Numerous [[Resistance officer]]s, including Alliance veterans, reviewed the documentations. In the documentation including the Braha'tok, Admiral [[Ushos O. Statura]] questioned who still used the gunship in an annotation. Ackbar replied by writing that Dornea still used them.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

[[File:BrahatokClassGunship-TROS.png|thumb|left|350px|A ''Braha'tok''-class gunship (below the cannon) is disabled by Darth Sidious's Force Lightning along with the other vessels of the Citizens' Fleet.]]
In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Calrissian and [[Chewbacca]] traveled to the [[Core Worlds]] to muster any starships that could assist the Resistance who were [[Battle of Exegol|fighting]] against [[Darth Sidious]] and the [[Sith Eternal]] at the planet [[Exegol]]. At least four ''Braha'tok''-class gunship joined the large [[Citizens' Fleet]] that replied to their call, travelling to Exegol to fight the Sith Eternal's fleet, the [[Final Order]]. Although the fleet was successful in destroying many [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]], Darth Sidious struck the starships with [[Force lightning]], disabling them. One Braha'tok was flying near General [[Poe Dameron]]'s [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] when both were disabled. However, the fleet were able to regain power and fight again after Sidious was distracted and killed by his granddaughter [[Rey Skywalker]]. Following their victory, the fleet traveled to the Resistance's [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on<ref name="Episode IX" /> the jungle moon<ref name="SWECG" /> [[Ajan Kloss]] for the victory celebrations.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Identity===
{{Quote|2003: I find a bunch of forgotten stills of the 'ROJ BG Ship' in a misfiled manila folder in image archives. Up until then, we fans only knew it as "the Y-head corvette" 2016: The Dornean gunship flies again as part of the Rebel fleet in Rogue One. It's the little things.|Pablo Hidalgo|<ref name="Pablo twitter 1">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1471701213003452416|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=2003: I find a bunch of forgotten stills of the 'ROJ BG Ship' in a misfiled manila folder in image archives. Up until then, we fans only knew it as "the Y-head corvette" 2016: The Dornean gunship flies again as part of the Rebel fleet in Rogue One. It's the little things.|archivedate=20211217100542}} {{C|In response to "Happy Anniversary to #RogueOne and the scene that literally caused me to shout an audible cheer of joy in the theatre. Best Star Wars film experience I ever had. Period."}}</ref>}}
[[File:Brahatok-class-gunship.jpg|thumb|right|350px|The ''Braha'tok''-class gunship first appeared in ''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi''.]]
The starship later known as the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship first appeared as a background ship in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the third installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]] which was directed by [[Richard Marquand]].<ref name="Episode VI" /> Its names ''Braha'tok''-class gunship and Dornean gunship originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity through the original [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]]<ref name="Dornean gunnship DB">{{DB|starship|dorneangunship|Dornean gunship}}</ref> on [[August 31]], [[2006]].<ref name="Round 6">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20060831.html|text=What's the Story, Round 6}}</ref>

In [[canon]] continuity, the name Dornean gunship was first mentioned in the [[2015]] novel ''[[Lost Stars]]'', written by [[Claudia Gray]], but not linked to the starship in ''Return of the Jedi''.<ref name="Lost Stars" /> However, the background ship reappeared in [[Gareth Edwards]]' [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|anthology]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Rogue One" /> and the Dornean gunship was mentioned in [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s [[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide|visual guide]] for the film released on the same day.<ref name="Ultimate Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> Hidalgo then referred to the background ship as the Dornean gunship in "Rogue One Secrets," an episode of ''[[The Star Wars Show]]'' uploaded onto [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] in early [[2017]], confirming that in the canon continuity the two were the same starship.<ref name="Rogue One Secrets">{{StarWarsShow|u7AuVg8OL3A|Rogue One Secrets Explained|sw_url=video/rogue-one-secrets-explained}}</ref> The name ''Braha'tok''-class gunship was reintroduced to canon through the 2017 reference book and box set ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Rebel Files" />

===Origins===
{{Quote|When I presented it to Joe Johnston he stated that it looked like "Something from Galactica". (That wasn't a compliment by the way.) Honestly I didn't even know that it was used in the film up until recently.|Bill George, on the origins of the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship|<ref name="Modeler's miniatures">{{WebCite|url=http://www.modelermagic.com/?p=90967|text=Laurent Perini's ROTJ and Rogue One Dornean Gunship|author=[https://modelermagic.com/author/kuhn-global/ Kuhn Global]|date=2017-05-06|quote=''The little hammerhead model has returned in Rogue One!''|archivedate=20200220165856}}</ref>}}
The first model of the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship was conceived by the [[Industrial Light & Magic]] model maker [[Bill George]] for ''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi''<ref name="Rogue One Secrets" /> after art director [[Joe Johnston]] asked him to create a background starship for the film. With little time to work with, George spent as little as two days designing the ship, mainly through [[Wikipedia:Kitbashing|kitbashing]], making the main body out of a very thin [[Wikipedia:Vacuum forming|vacuformed]] fuselage from an item on his kit wall. Due to how thin the model was, George strengthened it by filling it with [[Wikipedia:Urethane|urethane]], which made the object very heavy for its size. The finished design<ref name="Modeler's miniatures" /> was given the name "ROJ BG ship", standing for either '<nowiki/>''Return of the Jedi'' background ship' or '<nowiki/>''Return of the Jedi'' Bill George ship'.<ref name="Rogue One Secrets" />

[[File:Rj_bgship1.png|thumb|left|250px|Pablo Hidalgo found reference photos of the gunship's original model in a filing cabinet and posted them on StarWars.com.]]
When the ROJ BG ship was first presented to Johnston, the arts director was reportedly not satisfied,<ref name="Rogue One Secrets" /> saying it looked like a starship out of the [[Wikipedia:Battlestar Galactica|''Battlestar Galactica'']] franchise.<ref name="Modeler's miniatures" /> Subsequently, the ship had a very small role in the final film,<ref name="Rogue One Secrets" /> with George later stating that he had not even known it was used in the film until much later on.<ref name="Modeler's miniatures" /> However, fans latched onto the obscure background ship and, according to Pablo Hidalgo, it became celebrated,<ref name="Rogue One Secrets" /> receiving the nickname "the Y-head corvette."<ref name="Pablo twitter 1" /> The model of the gunship was stored in the [[Lucasfilm Archives]] while black and white<ref name="Pablo twitter 2">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/1087090995110469632|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=I found these photos as black and white 8 x 10s in an old folder in a filing cabinet in Lucasfilm's image unit in 2003 when I was researching some cantina alien stuff. The model is still in the Archives. Glad this ship was able to find new life. Check out this thread for more.|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgoBrahatokclassGunship.png|archivedate=20190722160501}} {{C|In response to "A few years ago, @pablohidalgo published a photo of the ILM model."}}</ref> reference photos<ref name="Celebration 2017">{{SWYouTube|85Jw-63YNYI|Star Wars Celebration Orlando 2017: Animated Origins and Unexpected Fates}}</ref> of it were stored in [[Lucasfilm]]'s image unit. In [[2003]], Hidalgo was researching the "[[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina|cantina]] [[alien]]s" when he found the photos<ref name="Pablo twitter 2" /> in manila folder in<ref name="Pablo twitter 1" /> a filing cabinet.<ref name="Pablo twitter 2" /> He chose to post the reference images on StarWars.com's member exclusive [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature [[Photoreceptor (Hyperspace)|Photoreceptor]] on [[June 6]] of that year.<ref name="Mystery Ship Solved">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/photoreceptor/2003/06/photoreceptor20030606.html|series=Photoreceptor|text=Mystery Ship Solved}}</ref>

Around three years later,<ref name="Round 6" /> the StarWars.com member "[[Ello137]]"<ref name="Dornean gunship DB">{{DB|starship|dorneangunship|Dornean gunship}}</ref> wrote a fan entry for the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship, which introduced its in-universe model names and backstory for the first time. Submitted to the forty-eighth contest of the Hyperspace feature "[[What's The Story?]]," the entry won and became the Databank entry for the "Dornean gunship." Ello137 saw the competition as an opportunity to link obscure elements of the Expanded Universe with obscure things in the movies. The user conceived the names ''[[Braha'tok]]'' and ''[[Torktarak]]''<ref name="Ello137 blog">{{Blog|apocalypselater|16/comments|What's the Story, Ello137? Funny you should ask …}}</ref> as gunships of the class,<ref name="Dornean gunship DB" /> intending them to be mythical [[Dornean/Legends|Dornean]] names.<ref name="Ello137 blog" />

===Development in canon===
{{Quote|We started building that model for ''Rebels'', they translated it into a photo real version for…er ''Rogue''.|Pablo Hidalgo details the new model for ''Star Wars Rebels'' and ''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story''|<ref name="Rogue One Secrets" />}}
[[File:Art_of_Rebels_Dornean_Gunship.jpg|thumb|right|320px|Concept art for the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship by Goran Josic for ''Star Wars Rebels''.]]
The ''Braha'tok''-class gunship found a second life<ref name="Art of Rebels">''[[The Art of Star Wars Rebels]]''</ref> when its own animation model was eventually made for the animated television show ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''{{'}}<ref name="Rogue One Secrets" /> [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|season three]] finale "[[Zero Hour]],"<ref name="Zero Hour EG">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/zero-hour-episode-guide|text="Zero Hour" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}}</ref> which made its debut on [[March 25]] 2017.<ref name="Zero Hour Release">{{WebCite|url=https://tvlistings.zap2it.com/tv/star-wars-rebels-zero-hour-part-one/EP018796240077|text=Star Wars Rebels : ''Zero Hour - Part One''|date=2017-02-08|work=[http://tvlistings.zap2it.com Screener]|archivedate=20170326180128}}</ref> The animation model was also translated into a photo-real version for ''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story''. Hidalgo later revealed details about the Braha'tok's behind the scenes history in "Rogue One Secrets"<ref name="Rogue One Secrets" /> and "Animated Origins and Unexpected Fates," a panel part of [[Celebration Orlando]] in 2017.<ref name="Celebration 2017" />

The Braha'tok was also included in a depiction of a [[Corellia]]n spaceport, flying above a landing area, in concept art for [[Ron Howard]]'s [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Art of Solo">''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> In [[2020]], the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship was brought as part of the [[JOYMAX]] mobile game ''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]''. The gunship was the opponent in one of the missions of the Empire faction, being combated above the<ref name="Starfighter Missions" /> [[gas giant]]<ref name="Bespin DB">{{Databank|bespin|Bespin}}</ref> [[Bespin]] with the objective being for the vessel to be destroyed. During the mission, the Braha'tok would fire concussion missiles which maintianed a straight course or eventually broke into bi-directional curved arcs while the turbolasers loosed slower moving explosive particles that partially scattered before detonating. The ''Braha'tok''-class gunship could be destroyed by successively taking out its weapons before targeting its engines and destroying the gunship.<ref name="Starfighter Missions" />

===Inconsistencies===
''Star Wars: The Rebel Files'', the [[Landry Q. Walker]]'s 2018 reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'', and [[Brandon Wainerdi]]'s [[2025]] reference book [[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]], claim that the crew of the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship is 75<ref name="Rebel Files" /><ref name="Starfighters2" /><ref name="Starfighters" /> whereas the 2018 and 2020 [[Fantasy Flight Games]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebooks ''[[Knights of Fate]]'' and ''[[Starships and Speeders]]'' set it as 70.<ref name="Knights of Fate">''[[Knights of Fate]]''</ref><ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> ''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'' and its second edition state the gunships hyperdrive to be class 1,<ref name="Starfighters2" /><ref name="Starfighters" /> but ''Knights of Fate'' and ''Starship and Speeders'' also contradicts this, setting it as class 3.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> This article uses the information from ''Knights of Fate'' and ''Starships and Speeders'' as the more recent sources.

The armament of the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship in ''Knights of Fate'' and ''Starships and Speeders''—two proton torpedo launchers, four concussion missile launchers, two twin light turbolaser cannons and eight quad laser cannons—also contradicts<ref name="Knights of Fate" /><ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> ''Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'',<ref name="Starfighters" /> its second edition,<ref name="Starfighters2" /> and [[Dorling Kindersley|DK publishing's]] [[2019]] reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'',<ref name="USWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> both of which claim the armament is eight concussion missile launchers and eight turbolasers.<ref name="Starfighters2" /><ref name="Starfighters" /><ref name="USWNE" /> ''Star Wars: The Rebel Files'' and ''[[The Art of Star Wars Rebels]]'', the book of concept art for the ''Star Wars Rebels'' written by Daniel Wallace and released in 2020, also state that the armament is concussion missile launchers and turbolasers.<ref name="Rebel Files" /><ref name="Art of Rebels" /> This article prioritizes the information on the armament given by ''Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'' and ''Ultimate Star Wars: New Edition''.

''The Art of Star Wars Rebels'' claims that starfighters could dock into a hangar in the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship,<ref name="Art of Rebels" /> whereas numerous other sources, including ''Rebel Files'', ''Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'' and its second edition, ''Knights of Fate'', ''Starships and Speeders'' and [[Alexander Freed]]'s 2015 novel ''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'', claim that the gunship carries the fighters on its undercarriage.<ref name="Rebel Files" /><ref name="Starfighters2" /><ref name="Starfighters" /><ref name="Knights of Fate" /><ref name="Starships and Speeders" /><ref name="Twilight Company" /> ''Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'' and its second edition further specify that the Braha'tok possesses attachment clips to carry the starfighters.<ref name="Starfighters2" /><ref name="Starfighters" /> This article ignores the information given by ''The Art of Star Wars Rebels'' in this case.
